ev.q: Recently, CDC assessed the evidence regarding hormonal contraceptive use and the risk for HIV acquisition, transmission, and disease progression.
Three systematic reviews conducted for WHO have summarized published evidence regarding the use of hormonal contraception
This report summarizes that assessment and the resulting updated guidance.
Three systematic reviews conducted for WHO have summarized published evidence regarding the use of hormonal contraception
With regard to the question about hormonal contraceptive use and risk for HIV acquisition among HIV-negative women, 20 observational studies were identified
